description: Urban Development Authority - Approval of the Development plan for the Development Area of Part of Hingurakgoda Pradeshiya Sabha
categorisation: The gazette names a specific government official (Bimal Rathnayake, Minister of Transport, Highways and Urban Development) and details the exercise of his powers under a specific Act to approve a specific development plan. This constitutes both the "who" (a named government person) and the "what" (a detailed action/decision taken under his statutory authority). According to the priority rules, when content contains both a person's name and detailed responsibilities/actions, it must be classified as Hybrid (Type 3).
